name: Nev Metal Works, LLC
old_description: Nev Metal Works, LLC is your trusted source for custom metal fabrication services.
about:
Nev Metal Works, LLC operates from Winterset, Iowa, a small city southwest of Des Moines. The company was founded in 2007 by owners who wanted to combine a passion for metalworking with a commitment to first‑class fabrication services for the Des Moines metro area. It is structured as a veteran‑owned and family‑owned corporation.

The shop provides one‑stop fabrication services that span custom metal fabrication, contract manufacturing, welding repair, sign fabrication, and design. Its process lineup includes CNC plasma and laser cutting, CNC forming (with a 100‑ton, 10‑foot press brake), CNC machining, MIG, TIG, and stick welding of ferrous and non‑ferrous metals, CNC router cutting, saw cutting, and CAD/3D design programming. The company describes its facility as having the capabilities of a large production operation while retaining a small‑business approach to customer service.

Customers come from agriculture, construction, automotive, and furniture manufacturing, among other sectors. The company cites repairs on large farm, construction, and auto equipment as well as small interior metal furniture, and notes that it can reverse‑engineer and reproduce parts for any industry.

Nev Metal Works says it differentiates itself by being able to fabricate new parts for any process at any quantity, blending large‑corporation quality with small‑business personalization. An up‑front pricing policy and a mission to deliver products and service of the utmost quality are also highlighted as core principles.
